nodes.description: Address of the contract owner (Ownable.owner), set from msg.sender and mutable via _transferOwnership.
Boolean pause flag (Pausable.paused) gating all token transfer entry points.
Mapping of account balances in BasicToken; mutated by transfer/transferFrom and initialized in the KM2Token constructor.
Total token supply storage in BasicToken, set to INITIAL_SUPPLY by the KM2Token constructor.
Nested allowance mapping in StandardToken, keyed by owner and msg.sender spender.
Mapping of frozen (blacklisted) addresses controlled by the owner in FrozenableToken.
Token name string "KinMall 2.0".
Token symbol string "KM2".
Token decimals, fixed at 18.
Immutable-style initial supply constant computed as 10000000 * 10**decimals.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, balance ownership, allowance keys and initial supply assignment.
Overflow-checked multiplication; performs raw multiplication then asserts c / _a == _b.
Truncating division; relies on Solidity's automatic revert on division by zero.
Underflow-checked subtraction using assert(b <= a) before the raw subtraction.
Overflow-checked addition using assert(c >= a) after the raw addition.
Deploy-time constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender without validation.
Modifier enforcing require(msg.sender == owner) on privileged functions.
Owner-only entry point delegating to _transferOwnership.
Internal ownership transfer that rejects the zero address and rewrites owner.
Owner-only function that sets paused = true.
Owner-only function that sets paused = false.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to _to using SafeMath sub/add on balances.
Read-only balance lookup for the supplied address.
Read-only total supply getter returning totalSupply_.
Allowance-based transfer debits balances[_from] and allowed[_from][msg.sender].
Sets allowance for _spender, requiring zero-or-existing-zero to mitigate the classic race.
Read-only allowance getter.
Adds _addedValue to the caller's allowance for _spender.
Subtracts _subtractedValue from the caller's allowance, clamping to zero when the value exceeds the current allowance.
whenNotPaused override delegating to StandardToken/BasicToken transfer.
whenNotPaused override delegating to StandardToken.transferFrom.
whenNotPaused override delegating to StandardToken.approve.
whenNotPaused override delegating to StandardToken.increaseApproval.
whenNotPaused override delegating to StandardToken.decreaseApproval.
Owner-only function that flips frozenAccount[_to] and emits FrozenFunds.
Deploy-time mint: assigns the whole supply to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts any plain ether sent to the token.
whenNotFrozen override of transfer delegating to PausableToken.transfer.
whenNotFrozen override of transferFrom delegating to PausableToken.transferFrom.
Modifier requiring both msg.sender and the target address to be unfrozen.
Raw multiplication c = _a * _b inside SafeMath.mul, guarded only by a post-hoc assert division check.
assert(c / _a == _b) verification inside SafeMath.mul; an unchecked assertion-style invariant.
Raw subtraction a - b inside SafeMath.sub guarded by assert(b <= a).
Raw addition c = a + b inside SafeMath.add guarded by assert(c >= a).
owner = msg.sender in the Ownable constructor without zero-address validation.
require(msg.sender == owner) authorization gate in onlyOwner; single-owner privilege surface.
balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) debit in BasicToken.transfer.
balances[_to].add(_value) credit in BasicToken.transfer.
allowed[_from][msg.sender].sub(_value) allowance debit in StandardToken.transferFrom.
require(!frozenAccount[msg.sender] && !frozenAccount[_who]) blacklist gate whose state is owner-controlled.
